title: FindsFile
description: data/finds.json: the finds of the first visit (spec 06). A find is one thing the plans letter on the block, with the lettering crop that names it. schema_version is 1.0.0. Shape only: that each feature_id is a published feature of its source, that each crop lies inside the source's map area, and that id, slug and order are unique are checked by `buried validate` (pipeline/buried_pipeline/validate/finds.py). Crops use the evidence Schema's cropPx shape: integer pixels on the full-resolution source raster, GDAL convention.

cropPx.description: An integer pixel rectangle on a source raster at full resolution (GDAL convention). The same shape as cropPx in evidence.schema.json.

reading.description: What one plan letters at the find, and the crop it was read from.

source.description: A source id, built as in structure.md: lowercase snake_case.

feature_id.description: <bld|use>_<source id>_<4 digits>: the published feature on that source.

lettered.description: The lines of lettering, exactly as lettered on the plan. The first line is the card title.

read_by.description: The person who read the lettering.

find.description: One find: a building or an area, with one reading per plan that letters it.

order.description: Position in the row of find tags; the lowest is the first find.

noun.description: One plain word for the thing, used in sentences.
